Waiting for customer data
Scroll / pinch to zoom · click a pin for the full address

Each of the 5,000 workbook customers has a mock address (flat/house, building, street, locality, 6-digit PIN) and a coordinate placed around the real centre of its town. PINs keep the workbook's 3-digit prefix. Localities in Mumbai, Pune, Thane, Nagpur, Nashik and other hubs use real area names with approximate positions; smaller towns use generic locality names. Nothing here is a real customer location. Demographic columns are not in the workbook, so none are shown. The records are synthetic educational data.
